title: Prawn (Shrimp) Biryani
tagline: A coastal favourite — juicy prawns in a quick spiced masala, layered with basmati.
intro: Prawn biryani is a treasured dish along the coasts of India and Pakistan. Because prawns cook in minutes, the masala is built first and the seafood is added briefly, keeping it plump and sweet. Light yet full of flavour, it's a faster biryani that still delivers all the aroma.

items: Whole spices: cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, bay leaf
½ tsp saffron in 3 tbsp milk

method: Rinse and soak the rice; drain. Season the prawns with a little salt, turmeric and lemon.
Fry the onions golden; add ginger–garlic paste, chillies and tomatoes.
Add the ground spices and yoghurt and cook to a thick masala.
Stir in the prawns and cook just 3–4 minutes until they turn pink. Do not overcook.
Layer rice over the prawn masala with saffron milk, fried onions, herbs and ghee.
Seal and dum on the lowest heat for 12–15 minutes only.
tips: Prawns turn rubbery if overcooked — keep the dum short.
A squeeze of lemon at the end lifts the whole dish.
toServe: Serve with a light raita and lemon wedges.
imageAlt: Prawn biryani with juicy shrimp and basmati rice
